About us

Accounting seen from inside management

Nest4Ideas was founded to be more than a traditional accounting practice. We are a team of Certified Accountants who have also worked on the other side, in financial control and management at multinational companies.

That changes how we work: we do not treat accounting as an end in itself, but as a tool that helps managers make better decisions. We work with SMEs and managers who want more than just hitting deadlines, they want to understand the business through the numbers.

We work with no offices and no paper. The team is split between Madeira and the mainland and every process is digital, so we can work with you wherever you are in the country.
